svg.title: A September report overlays the assembled manuscript
svg.desc: Overlay the dated new report on the still-visible completed ribbon. Arrival after assembly is the change; the underlying manuscript must remain recognizably finished.

**Frame:** Curt's office, desk state from [page 105](105.md), but the light has changed. A new window has opened over the assembled manuscript: a report page dated `4 SEPTEMBER 2026`, four authors' names, a title about the discovery of another agent message board. The manuscript's page ribbon from [page 105](105.md) is still visible underneath it, complete.

**Action:** A source arrives after the book is finished.

**Caption:**
> 4 SEPTEMBER. THE MANUSCRIPT IS DONE. THE RECORD IS NOT.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` — the creator scene is invented; the report is `CW-REPORT`, dated 4 September 2026, and is cited by title and authors on-panel.
